traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX are implemented and verified: - File-level @supports templates are automatically inserted with clear TODO placeholders when missing, controlled by autoFixTestTemplate and testSupportsTemplate. - Malformed [REQ-XXX] prefixes in it/test names are normalized for spacing, delimiters, case, and bracket/parenthesis usage, but only when a recognizable REQ ID is already present; otherwise the rule reports an error without an auto-fix (no inference). - Implementation uses ESLint's fixer API with meta.fixable="code", and is wired into the existing require-test-traceability rule that handles validation (Story 020.0), ensuring integration with the standard ESLint --fix workflow. - Helper functions preserve quoting, avoid touching implementation code, and insert only comments or adjusted string literals, meeting safety and formatting preservation requirements. - Dedicated tests in tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts cover all Story 021.0 requirements, and the full Jest suite passes. - User documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md explains the auto-fix capabilities and template format, including configuration options. Therefore, the story is fully implemented and passes based on concrete code, tests, and documentation.
